response.sql: WITH patient_ratios AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB / HCT) AS ratio FROM Laboratory WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL AND HCT <> 0 GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS average_ratio FROM patient_ratios), above_overall AS (SELECT p.ID, p.ratio FROM patient_ratios AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.ratio > o.average_ratio), second_average AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS average_ratio FROM above_overall) SELECT AVG(a.ratio) AS average_ratio, AVG(a.ratio - o.average_ratio) AS average_above_overall, AVG(a.ratio - s.average_ratio) AS average_above_second FROM above_overall AS a CROSS JOIN overall AS o CROSS JOIN second_average AS s WHERE a.ratio > s.average_ratio
